card_text: Sending bulk WhatsApp messages safely, without bans.
title: Bulk WhatsApp Messages: The Safe Way
h1: Bulk WhatsApp messages: how to send them without getting banned
author: Hiten Neotia
excerpt: How to send bulk WhatsApp messages safely: why unofficial senders get numbers banned, how the official API works, and the steps to send at scale.

faqs.q: Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages from the normal app?
faqs.a: Not safely. Bulk sending from the app or with unofficial tools is against WhatsApp's terms and often leads to a banned number.

faqs.q: How many bulk messages can I send per day?
faqs.a: On the API, your daily limit depends on your messaging tier, which grows with good quality and volume.

faqs.q: Do I need the contact's permission?
faqs.a: Yes. You need opt-in from every contact before sending business-initiated messages.

content_html:
Bulk WhatsApp messages: how to send them without getting banned

You can send bulk WhatsApp messages safely only through the official WhatsApp Business API, to people who opted in, using approved templates. Unofficial bulk senders, browser extensions and "WhatsApp Web" tools break WhatsApp's terms, and numbers that use them are often banned within days. The official route takes a little setup, but it lets you send thousands of personalised messages with your verified business name and full delivery reports.

Why bulk senders get numbers banned

WhatsApp watches for spam patterns. Unofficial tools typically send the same text to many unknown numbers in a short time, from a normal WhatsApp account. Recipients block and report the number, and WhatsApp's systems act quickly. In addition, these tools often need your phone to stay connected, they cannot use templates, and they offer no proper opt-out. So even if a tool works today, the risk grows with every send. Our guide on unbanning a WhatsApp number covers what happens after a ban.

The official way to send bulk WhatsApp messages

  1. Get API access. Register your number on the WhatsApp Cloud API, ideally with a verified Meta business portfolio.
  2. Collect opt-in. Every contact must have agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from you.
  3. Create templates. Write and submit the message as a template, in the right category.
  4. Upload your audience. Import opted-in contacts with any personal fields you need.
  5. Send in stages. Start with a small batch, check results, then send the rest.

Preparing your contact list

A clean list protects your quality rating. Before sending:

  • Remove duplicates and numbers without a country code.
  • Remove anyone who opted out, on any channel.
  • Check where each contact came from, and drop any without clear consent.
  • Split the list by language, city or interest if you can.

Format numbers consistently, for example +91 followed by ten digits. Otherwise, some messages will fail.

Sending in stages

New numbers have a daily limit on how many customers they can message first. The limit rises as you send good-quality messages. So do not try to reach 50,000 people on day one. Instead, start with your most engaged contacts, who are least likely to block you. Then expand over days or weeks while watching the quality rating in WhatsApp Manager. Our WhatsApp broadcast messaging guide explains limits in more detail.

Personalising each message

Bulk does not have to mean generic. Templates can include the customer's name, last purchase, city or appointment time. They can also carry an image, a document and buttons. A personal message with one clear action earns far more replies than a mass blast. As a result, your cost per result falls even though the message cost stays the same.

After the send

Replies will come in, often within minutes. Have a chatbot or agents ready. Then check the report: delivered, read, replied, clicked and blocked. If blocks are high, the message or the audience was wrong. Fix that before the next send. See WhatsApp analytics for what to track.

What bulk messages cost

On the API, Meta charges per delivered template, based on category and country. Our per-message pricing guide explains the details. Compared with the cost of losing a number, it is a small price.

Getting set up

We help businesses move from risky bulk senders to the official API, clean their lists and send bulk WhatsApp messages safely, through our WhatsApp AI chatbot and automation service. For B2B senders, our earlier article on the best WhatsApp sender for B2B in India may also help.

Frequently asked questions

Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages from the normal app?

Not safely. Bulk sending from the app or with unofficial tools is against WhatsApp's terms and often leads to a banned number.

How many bulk messages can I send per day?

On the API, your daily limit depends on your messaging tier, which grows with good quality and volume.

Do I need the contact's permission?

Yes. You need opt-in from every contact before sending business-initiated messages.
